race.comment: BOLD BLAZE (1) returns from a short spell and has only missed once here at this track from 5 starts - the definition of a track specialist. Carries the big weight but has trialled strongly well and is the one to beat on his peak ratings. REPLACE THE ACE (2) couldn't go on with the job last time at Mackay but the winner was dominant and his run here two back adds depth. Best figures measure up nicely and the inside draw will give him a great look stretching to a trip he relishes. LATIN LOVE (5) improved sharply on her fifth two starts back at the Sunny Coast with success here over the mile last time. Not a great deal tougher this time and sets up well with the 2kg claimer taking over. Gets a good chance to repeat the dose. ALOYSIUS (3) comes through a few good form references and is one to keep in mind for the minors.
